training.recovery_selection: latest saved recovery by step only, never validation score
training.sampling: Same 25% color quartets, 25% navigation, 40% state calibration, 10% retained primitive schedule. State calibration uses one same-image quartet [v,-v,0,v/2] per microbatch; domains 25/25/50% and tasks 2..6 cycle. Common flow noise/time across the quartet; t=1 on even steps, sampled common time on odd steps. Other sampling unchanged.
training.loss: Flow matching on six normalized action channels, weights [8,8,1,1,1,1], divided by their sum; runtime units and normalization unchanged.
training.data: Same pixels/states/sampling and teacher laws as train07 except approach teacher standoff restored to 1.0m. The score goal remains 0.9m.
training.frozen_backbone: All vision-language parameters; train action expert and state/action projections only. Verify frozen parameter digest before and after training.
training.image_domains: Explicit per-image domains; new views are appended after the 6408 existing image IDs.

teacher.scope: Training labels only; frozen velocity-to-attitude controller already subtracts current estimated velocity.
teacher.reason: A completed development mission met the target stop but drifted to 0.4468m from a person during landing, failing the unchanged 0.45m clearance. Restore a 10cm teacher safety margin before landing; do not relax success criteria or alter runtime.

data.unchanged: All pixels, state examples, prompts, splits, nonhorizontal labels, runtime and scoring.

evaluation: Unchanged: dev 8/8; exposed stress >=14/16, >=7/8 each color, >=3/4 each layout; regression 5/5; known failure 1/1; then fresh matched 16 per model and preregistered static probe.
hypotheses_not_results: A 10cm teacher standoff margin reduces post-stop/landing proximity while retaining the sharper approach teacher and zero horizontal hold targets. This has not yet been verified for the new candidate.
All primitive, stressed, video, known-failure, fresh paired and color-intervention gates remain required; no checkpoint or trial is selected by outcome.
